svg.title: Long-context true-mixed scenario-level TTFT
svg.desc: Scenario-level TTFT P50 and P95 comparing load-balanced and KV-aware routing with verified mixed-prefix distribution.
svg.text: Two-run mean · 4 KiB / 12 KiB prefixes · mixed = 60 hot / 20 unique / 20 other shared
Negative change means KV-aware is faster. Mixed rows now represent the complete 60 / 20 / 20 distribution.
